news.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
news.summary: A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services tie up while customers’ payments clear.

news.title: Crypto traders seek shelter in bitcoin as altcoins slide and ETF flows wobble
Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines
news.summary: Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.

news.title: Crypto traders price India telecoms company Reliance Jio's IPO at about $110 billion
news.summary: The pre-IPO Jio contract on Bitget is trading near $12, a roughly 4% premium on the top price band, as India’s largest public offering remains open for subscription.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slumps below $82,000 as markets go risk off on AI selloff, oil surge
news.summary: South Korea's Kospi tumbled 3.5% overnight, and oil gained nearly 3% on renewed Middle East hostilities.

news.title: Asian stocks tumble, bitcoin retreats as China enters bear market
news.summary: Technology shares led regional losses as mixed U.S. earnings unsettled investors and Brent crude climbed above $112 a barrel.

news.title: China seeks to seize 61,800 BTC tied to $5.7 billion fraud scheme
news.summary: Chinese prosecutors are seeking to confiscate more than 61,800 Bitcoin tied to a $5.7 billion fraud scheme, days after a U.K. court ruled Chinese law governs victims’ claims to the coins.

news.title: Solana’s biggest network change since 2020 is live. Here’s how users benefit
news.summary: The new voting system targets settlement in about 150 milliseconds, potentially shortening waits for payments and deposits. Users can keep their existing wallets.

news.title: Markets are pricing in long-term AI winners. This veteran investor says history proves customers win more than innovators.
news.summary: Rob Arnott, chairman of Syzygy Asset Management, says the perceived AI winners of today may be far from reality.

news.title: Oil is now flowing out of the Persian Gulf like before the Iran war. Why prices may still not come down anytime soon.
news.summary: Oil flows out of the Persian Gulf in October nearly returned to levels seen before the start of the Iran war, but traders remain wary about a fragile recovery.

news.title: Moderna is about to release the trial results for its cancer vaccine. A lot is riding on this data.
news.summary: Moderna is one of the hottest stocks of the year because of its custom cancer treatment. Full Phase 3 data are set to be revealed this weekend.

news.title: IBM’s stock falls as investors struggle to shake off July earnings miss
news.summary: Shares in International Business Machines declined 5% in Thursday’s premarket trading as investors digested the company’s third-quarter results.

news.title: Why this JPMorgan strategist thinks the stock market’s tailspin might have run its course
news.summary: Hedge fund positioning has lightened considerably since its recent September peak, and JPMorgan strategists deduce from this that downside for stocks is now limited.

news.title: Mideast oil exports are recovering. Fresh attacks in Saudi Arabia show risks remain.
news.summary: More oil is flowing out of the Persian Gulf again, with exports approaching prewar levels. So why are prices so stubbornly high?

news.title: Meta teases an opportunity even bigger than advertising — but its stock is falling
news.summary: Meta’s core advertising business delivered a strong quarter, but investors are now eyeing promising new businesses around the Muse personal assistant.
